project_type: Astro 7 + React 19 islands catalogue storefront. Static storefront prerendered to dist/client; deploys to Cloudflare Workers, with a Netlify prerender target. TypeScript throughout.
build_system: npm scripts wrapping astro + tsx; wrangler for local Worker state (not needed for this task)
test_framework: Vitest (unit + property, `vitest run`). Playwright e2e exists but is not required here (no live browser available).
build_command: npm run build  (prebuild: validate:content -> astro build -> postbuild audits: check-motion-budget, emit-redirects, audit-seo, audit-csp, audit-page-budget, audit-image-loading, lint-keyword-density). May need PUBLIC_SITE_URL env; CI falls back to http://localhost:4321. Set PUBLIC_SITE_URL=http://localhost:4321 if the build complains.
test_command: npm test  (vitest run). Targeted: npx vitest run tests/unit/homepage.contracts.test.ts
verification_instructions: 1) Edit data/site/settings.json to enable the logo asset. 2) npm run check (astro check && tsc --noEmit) => 0 errors. 3) npm run build must PASS all 7 postbuild audits, especially scripts/audit-image-loading.ts. 4) Inspect dist/client HTML/CSS to confirm the logo renders with the correct src, width, height, alt, is wrapped in an , and sits in a reserved box. 5) npm test: reconcile the one test that will break (tests/unit/homepage.contracts.test.ts asserts settings.placeholders contains 'site.logo.src' and settings.logo.src is null). No NEW unrelated failures. 6) Reason about responsive widths from the built CSS since there is no live browser; state clearly what is verified via build/DOM/CSS vs. what needs a human eyeball.
snapshot_or_generated_files: dist/ is generated by npm run build and git-ignored. No checked-in snapshots affected by this task.
setup_instructions: Node >=22.12.0. Run `npm ci` (or `npm install`) only if node_modules is missing. Unit tests and the build need no live Cloudflare resources. Do NOT run any --remote wrangler command.
environment_constraints: No live browser: responsive/visual verification is by build output + CSS reasoning only, not a real render. Do NOT commit or push (user requirement). Leave untracked files from prior tasks alone (.agents/, scripts/repair-sofa-kv.ts).
contribution_requirements: Smallest correct change. Only the logo/header wiring and the spacing fix. Do NOT modify unrelated pages/components. Do NOT change the overall header design, navigation, animations, or responsive behavior beyond removing the excess space. Preserve the logo artwork exactly (do not recreate/regenerate/redraw/substitute). If trimming empty background is justified, trim ONLY whitespace, keep aspect ratio, and update intrinsic width/height to the trimmed file's real dimensions.
key_patterns: BrandMark.astro already has first-class logo support: when settings.logo.src is a path it renders wrapped in , and drops the wordmark + champagne hairline automatically. The schema (src/schemas/site.ts) superRefine makes logo.width AND logo.height REQUIRED (positive ints) as soon as logo.src is non-null. A file in public/ is served at its path minus 'public/': public/brand/new-galaxy-furniture-logo.jpeg -> '/brand/new-galaxy-furniture-logo.jpeg'. getPlaceholderKeys()/recomputePlaceholders (src/lib/site/store.ts) drop 'site.logo.src' from placeholders once logo.src is non-null; settings.json currently lists it, so remove it to keep the checklist truthful and match store behavior.
image_audit_constraint: scripts/audit-image-loading.ts audits EVERY in dist/client. For the logo it matters that: (a) it carries intrinsic width AND height attributes (BrandMark emits them from settings, which is why the schema requires them); (b) it is loading='lazy' decoding='async' (BrandMark uses loadingAttributes() with no args => lazy/async — correct, it is not the LCP); (c) it sits in a 'reserved box'. inReservedBox() checks the img's ANCESTORS for aspect-ratio or a fixed absolute height, OR an ancestor whose class the built CSS gives a fixed height/aspect-ratio to. classesReservingBox() collects class names from any CSS rule whose body has 'height: px' etc. The rule '.ngf-brand-md .ngf-brand-asset { height: 32px }' therefore registers BOTH 'ngf-brand-md' and 'ngf-brand-asset' as reserving classes, and the 's ancestor carries class 'ngf-brand-md', so the box IS reserved. VERIFY this holds in the actual built CSS after the change; if the audit reports the logo, that is the thing to fix (smallest correct change) rather than disabling the audit.
asset_facts: public/brand/new-galaxy-furniture-logo.jpeg is the real user-provided asset: 1254x1254 px (square), 54477 bytes, JPEG. It is the source of truth. Do NOT redesign it. It has substantial empty margin around the artwork; because the header renders it at 32px tall and it is square, the visible mark may look small/over-padded. Trimming surrounding EMPTY background is permitted ONLY if genuinely necessary for correct header sizing; if trimmed, keep aspect ratio, alter no artwork, and set logo.width/height to the trimmed file's real dimensions.
spacing_diagnosis_hint: The header is position:sticky top:0 (occupies flow, so it does not overlay a gap). Likely source of 'excessive empty space below the header': .ngf-brand is display:inline-flex; flex-direction:column; gap:0.375rem, and in wordmark mode adds a champagne hairline via .ngf-brand[data-brand-source='wordmark']::after (height 1px + margin-top 0.375rem) plus @media(max-width:767px) .ngf-brand { min-height:44px; justify-content:center }. Header padding is .ngf-header{padding:0.75rem 1rem 0} and .ngf-header-inner{padding:0.5rem 0.75rem}. Swapping to the asset auto-removes the wordmark hairline, but the column gap and mobile min-height still pad a 32px image. The coder must diagnose the ACTUAL excess against the built output/CSS and remove it with the smallest correct change (e.g. scope the vertical rhythm/gap to wordmark mode, or trim header/brand padding), keeping the touch target and everything else intact.
directory_structure: src/components/ui/ = header + brand components. src/styles/shell.css = shell/header/brand CSS. src/schemas/ = Zod schemas incl. site settings. src/lib/content/site.ts = settings loader + getPlaceholderKeys. src/lib/site/store.ts = admin settings patch + recomputePlaceholders. data/site/settings.json = committed site settings (the swap-in point). public/brand/ = static brand assets. scripts/ = postbuild audits. tests/unit/ = Vitest unit tests.
